purpose: Teach: 心底/まんが/諸々/愛想/すばやく/はまり/ゆで/まだしも

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、心底ホッとしたわよ
lines.style: Warm exhale, shoulders settling. Genuine tenderness without performance. Eyes soft. Speaking as someone who has been holding worry and is finally letting it go.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんとまんが描いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drew manga with you!
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Quick attack on the first word — he's bursting to tell her. Small proud smile in the voice. Natural child's rhythm, no affectation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、諸々のお絵描き道具、用意してきたわよ
lines.en: Sho, I brought all kinds of art supplies for us.
lines.style: Warm and purposeful. She's thought ahead — gentle pride in having prepared. Soft on 'us,' making it their activity together. Generous tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達に愛想良くするように心がけてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really trying to be friendlier with other kids.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly self-conscious. He's making an effort and wants her to know it mattered. Small pause before admitting it — vulnerability without drama. Genuine child's sincerity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんも、すばやく絵を仕上げるのよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm going to finish my drawing quickly too.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. She's matching his energy — settling into the moment with him. Gentle and present. A promise made softly, not as instruction but as presence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵にすっかりはまりこんでるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm totally absorbed in drawing right now.
lines.style: Lit up, present in the work. Voice has flow and focus. The contentment of being immersed. Small child's unselfconscious joy — not trying to impress, just being.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんがゆで栗を持ってきて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother's bringing boiled chestnuts.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact kindness. She's sharing a small joy — the practical comfort of a snack and care arriving. Slight lift on 'chestnuts,' making it a small gift in the telling.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵ならまだしも、漢字は苦手だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can do art fine, but kanji is really hard for me.
lines.style: Wry and honest, a small rueful laugh under it. He's being straightforward about his limits without shame. Self-aware in a kid-like way — matter-of-fact, slightly amused at himself.
